events.title: 月末调仓 · 养老金/基金再平衡
events.note: 月末指数与养老金/基金再平衡资金流,尾盘最后几分钟常有巨量买/卖盘。
events.note_en: Month-end index + pension/fund rebalancing flows; the last minutes of the session often see outsized buy/sell prints.

events.title: MSCI 季度指数审议生效
events.note: MSCI 季度成分调整生效;权重最大的纳入/剔除名单常在尾盘出现巨量买卖(名单由 MSCI 提前约 2 周公布)。
events.note_en: MSCI quarterly constituent changes take effect; the largest additions/deletions often see outsized closing prints (MSCI publishes the list ~2 weeks ahead).

events.title: 四巫日 · 标普/纳指季度调仓
events.note: 指数期货/期权 + 个股期货/期权同时到期,标普 & 纳斯达克季度成分调整同日生效,尾盘量常暴增。
events.note_en: Index + single-stock futures & options all expire; S&P & Nasdaq-100 quarterly rebalances take effect the same day — closing volume usually spikes.

events.title: 月度期权交割 · OPEX
events.note: 月度股票期权到期;gamma 墙常在此前后移动或减弱。
events.note_en: Monthly stock options expire; gamma walls often shift or weaken around it.
